verdict_reason: The ruling matches the ticket and its Sam-ruling citations check out, but one line reference is off by one and point 4 overstates what ruling:ian-2026-11-11 point 2 covers.

todos.issue: Point 2 cites sources/ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm.md:270 for the 'Design question 5, live filtering (claim 9). Applied by the orchestrator from Sam's principle (point 3b)' heading, but at this commit line 270 is the last line of claim 14 ('Replaces c-006's clause ... New.') and the heading is line 271. The other citations (:233-242, :273-275, :276) are right.
todos.fix: Must: every file:line citation in the ruling points at the line it quotes. One way: change :270 to :271.

todos.issue: Point 4 says ruling:ian-2026-11-11 point 2 'already bars a row from resting on what the prototype happened to hard-code', but that point is scoped to data: 'No row may rest on the prototype's app/data/*.js files for what data a notification captures, which values a field offers, or which commodities a rule covers ... A claim of kind data taken from them' (ruling-ian-2026-11-11.md:25-28). prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-063 is a page-behaviour claim ('A picker lists only addresses whose types include the section's role', reconciled.json:2708), not a data claim, so the earlier ruling does not already bar it. A re-distil reading this sentence may stretch 11-11 point 2 to every prototype behaviour claim.
todos.fix: Must: point 4 either rests on its own reasoning (the fixture holds too few records to show paging) or states plainly that it extends 11-11 point 2 from data to page behaviour, rather than saying 11-11 already covers it. One way: replace 'already bars' with 'This extends ruling:ian-2026-11-11 point 2, which bars a row resting on the prototype's demo data, to its demo page sizes.'
